description: Known, accepted validation debt. Findings listed here are reported by py/validate_quality.py as WARN (tracked debt) instead of blocking ERROR, so pre-existing problems do not prevent new work from passing its completion gate. Anything NOT listed here still blocks. Run with --no-baseline to see the unsuppressed truth.
rules: Every entry must carry a reason and an owner action. Debt is tracked, not forgiven.
Do not add an entry to silence a finding produced by work you just did. This file is for pre-existing debt only.
Remove an entry the moment the underlying problem is fixed; the validator reports stale entries.

entries.reason: National 2008 row cites metadata index 31, a WHO multi-country situation report published 29 Oct 2025 covering 2025-01-01..2025-09-28. A 2025 document cannot substantiate 2008 data, so the citation is wrong; the underlying case numbers may still be correct.
entries.action: Identify the source that actually supports Angola's 2008 national figures (WHO AFRO bulletin or WER for that year), re-register it, and repoint source_index. If no source can be found, reduce confidence_weight and mark the row provisional.

entries.reason: As above for the national 2010 row, citing the same 2025 situation report.

Row covers all of 2023 (30,000 cases) but cites metadata index 12, an OCHA flash update covering 8-20 June 2023. A dated bulletin cannot substantiate a full-year total. The row label was deliberately NOT normalised to that title, which would have turned a vague citation into a precisely wrong one.
entries.action: Find the source of the 2023 annual total (WHO AFRO annual bulletin or EPHI year-end report), register it, and repoint source_index.

entries.reason: Migori County row cites metadata index 16, titled 'Kenya Homa Bay County 2015 Outbreak'. Migori and Homa Bay are adjacent Nyanza counties and a single 2015 report may cover both, but the citation as written names a different county than the row.
entries.action: Check whether the cited Homa Bay report also reports Migori. If it does, widen the metadata Source/Description; if not, find the Migori source.

entries.reason: Eritrea has a header-only cholera_data_ai.csv. Eritrea does not publish routine cholera surveillance and is absent from the WHO weekly feed, so no AI rows were ever established. This is a true finding, not a defect to suppress.
entries.action: Expected to be resolved by the full re-run. If the re-run also yields nothing, that is itself the result: record it as a documented non-reporting country rather than leaving an empty file.

entries.reason: Consequence of the empty ERI dataset above - no metadata entries exist, so dual-reference integrity cannot be checked.
entries.action: Resolved automatically once the re-run registers any Eritrea source.
